title: A Survey of Mixture-of-Experts Inference Systems
scope: System techniques that make MoE model inference faster, cheaper or fit in less memory. Training-only work is out.

research_questions.question: Which inference bottlenecks of MoE models do systems target?
Which technique families are used, at which system layer?
How are these systems evaluated, and how comparable are the results?

inclusion.rule: Proposes or evaluates a system or algorithm for MoE model inference.
Has an experimental evaluation or a detailed system design.

exclusion.rule: Only about MoE training or model architecture quality.
Not a research paper (tutorial, opinion, patent, thesis duplicate).
Duplicate of an included paper (keep the published version).

notes: Assumptions and questions for the human.
